# Mahamodul Hasan Moon

> Mahamodul Hasan Moon is a full-stack developer, AI automation specialist and DevOps engineer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, with 6+ years of experience. He builds APIs and web apps with Node.js, NestJS and Next.js, automates business workflows with AI, and deploys with Docker, GitHub Actions, Nginx and AWS. He founded Brainicsoft Digital in 2023.

## Key facts
- Role: Full Stack Developer, AI Automation Specialist & DevOps Engineer
- Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh (works with clients worldwide)
- Experience: 6+ years
- Agency: Brainicsoft Digital (Founder, CEO & Lead Software Engineer), founded 2023
- Previous roles: Backend Engineer at Hunny IT; Software Engineer at Edu Fixup
- Languages: Bengali, English
- Email: moon@brainicsoft.com
- Upwork: https://www.upwork.com/freelancers/~017c4931e01d47e960
- Fiverr: https://www.fiverr.com/moon_mahamodul
- GitHub: https://github.com/mahamodulhasanmoon

## Services
- Full Stack Development: Complete web applications, frontend to backend, built with Next.js, React, Node.js, NestJS and TypeScript on PostgreSQL or MongoDB.
- AI Automation: Repetitive business workflows automated with AI, connected to your existing APIs, databases and tools.
- Docker & CI/CD: Docker and GitHub Actions pipelines: push to main, tested and deployed in about 90 seconds.
- AWS & VPS Deployment: Servers on AWS EC2, DigitalOcean, Contabo or Hostinger with Nginx, SSL and zero-downtime releases.
- Payment Integration: Online checkout and payment flows with Stripe for international payments and bKash and SSLCommerz for Bangladesh.
- Ongoing Support: Monitoring, logs, backups and improvements after launch, so the product keeps running well.

## Case studies
- Raisedly.com: Modern Responsive Website (Lead Developer): Quick load times, intuitive navigation and a premium look on all devices, which improved user engagement.
- SolvenSystem: ERP Deployment & DevOps (Full Stack Developer & DevOps Specialist): A stable, supported ERP in production. The client recorded a video testimonial about working together.
- Automated AWS EC2 Deployment with CI/CD (DevOps Specialist): Deploy time cut from about 30 minutes to about 90 seconds, with zero downtime, instant rollback and HTTPS.
- Global Capitals: FinTech Platform (Full Stack Developer): A working multi-role FinTech platform. The client recorded a video testimonial about the quality of the work.
